name: JV_CONTRIBUTION_REFERENCES
description: This table contains transaction references that are associated with the partner contribution.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the partner contribution transaction reference.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the partner contribution that the transaction is associated with.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of transaction associated with the partner contribution. This is based on ORA_JV_PC_TRANSACTION_TYPE. Transaction types include: Partner Contribution AR Invoice, Close AP Invoice, or Close Journal Entry.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the transaction associated with this advance payment. This will reference a Journal Entry, AR Invoice or AP Invoice.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number associated with the partner contribution. This will reference a Journal Entry, AR Invoice, or AP Invoice.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date associated with the partner contribution.  This will reference a Journal Entry, AR Invoice, or AP Invoice.

columns.name: CANCEL_FLAG
columns.description: A flag that indicates the transaction has been cancelled. A 'Y' indicates that the transaction has been cancelled.

columns.name: CANCEL_DATE
columns.description: Date the transaction was cancelled.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount of the transaction. This amount will be applied to the contribution amount and open amount.

columns.name: RELATED_CONTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of a partner contribution related to this transaction. This will be populated when the type of transaction is transfer from or transfer to.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the partner contribution transaction amount.

columns.name: REFUND_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount to be refunded to the partner when the partner contribution is closed.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_DEFAULT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The amount charged to the partner when closing the partner contribution.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_DEFAULT_CCID
columns.description: The account combination identifier for the agreement default charge account used when closing the partner contribution.

columns.name: CLOSE_DATE
columns.description: The date the partner contribution was closed.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PRIOR_CONTRIBUTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the partner contribution prior to creating a transaction to open, cancel, close, or transfer the partner contribution. In the case of a transfer to a new partner contribution, this is the status code that you selected for the new partner contribution after you accounted the transfer transaction. It is based on ORA_JV_CONTRIBUTION_STATUS lookup codes such as Invoiced, Available to Draw, and so forth.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_REF_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the partner contribution transaction line. It is based on ORA_JV_PC_TRANSACTION_STATUS lookup codes such as Process complete, Ready to cancel, and so forth.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_REASON_CODE
columns.description: The code that indicates the reason for canceling the partner contribution transaction line. It is based on ORA_JV_PC_TRAN_REASON_CODE lookup codes such as Partner contribution not paid, Partner contribution created in error, or other user defined values.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: The transaction amount in the ledger currency.

columns.name: ORIG_CONTRIBUTION_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the original partner contribution transaction reference. This is populated when a transaction is canceled.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
